title: A Queue You Can Loop Over

args: const q = makeQueue([1, 2]); const out = []; for (const a of q) for (const b of q) out.push(a * 10 + b); return out;
const q = makeQueue(["x", "y", "z"]); const out = []; for (const a of q) for (const b of q) out.push(a + b); return out.length;
const q = makeQueue([7]); const [first] = q; return [first, ...q];
